shortDescription: Evaluates Apache Cassandra workloads for migration to Amazon Keyspaces: monthly cost, compatibility, and functional readiness.

agentCard.name: Keyspaces Migration
agentCard.description: Evaluates Apache Cassandra clusters, CQL schemas, and SQL data models for migration to Amazon Keyspaces. Estimates monthly cost (on-demand vs provisioned, savings plans, multi-Region, PITR, TTL, self-managed TCO), flags unsupported Cassandra features, generates the target Keyspaces CloudFormation data model, and produces a PDF report.

extensions.name: Agent Connectors
extensions.description: Connector types used by this agent

skills.name: Keyspaces cost estimate
skills.description: Monthly Amazon Keyspaces cost from manual workload inputs or nodetool diagnostics: on-demand vs provisioned, savings plans, multi-datacenter, PITR, TTL, and optional self-managed Cassandra TCO comparison.

skills.name: Keyspaces compatibility check
skills.description: Flags Cassandra features Amazon Keyspaces does not support (secondary indexes, triggers, materialized views, UDFs, UDAs, LWT in unlogged batches, aggregate queries) with what-to-do-instead guidance.

skills.name: Keyspaces functional readiness
skills.description: Generates the target Keyspaces data model as CloudFormation, reports TTL tables and multi-Region topology, and lists required application changes.

skills.name: SQL to Keyspaces modeling
skills.description: Translates a relational SQL model into three Keyspaces modeling strategies, prices each, and recommends the best fit.
